content.title: About
content.content: Baby Toddler Cereal, Multigrain, Ready-to-Eat is a nutritious blend of whole grains (oats, rice, wheat, corn) fortified with vitamins, specially formulated for children from 6 months old. The cereal has a soft texture, dissolves easily in milk or water, and requires no cooking.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The blend contains several grain types, providing a broader range of nutrients.
The product meets strict quality standards and complies with infant‑food regulations in the EU and the US.
No artificial colors, flavors, or preservatives are added.
Each serving is enriched with iron, zinc, and B‑vitamins essential for growth and development.
Packaging is made from recyclable material and features a convenient dispenser.

items.title: Source of complex carbohydrates
items.content: The multigrain mix supplies steady energy needed for an active toddler.

items.title: Rich in iron
items.content: Iron supports hemoglobin formation and helps prevent anemia in young children.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamins B1, B2, B6 aid normal nervous system function and metabolism.

items.title: Calcium and vitamin D
items.content: Promote the development of strong bones and teeth during early growth.

items.title: Dietary fiber
items.content: Supports healthy digestion and helps prevent constipation.

items.title: Grain allergy
items.content: Children with known allergies to wheat, oats, or corn should be evaluated by a pediatrician before introducing the product.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: While no added sugar is present, some versions may contain small amounts of natural sugars.

items.title: Not suitable for infants under 6 months
items.content: Younger infants may have an immature digestive system, so introduction is recommended after six months.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Mix one serving (about 30 g) with 120 ml of warm breast milk, formula, or water. Stir thoroughly until smooth. Serve immediately while warm.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the package in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. After opening, reseal tightly and use within 4 weeks. Discard if any off‑odor, mold, or discoloration appears.
